---
title: "`r params$title`"
subtitle: "`r params$country`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 2
params:
  title: "ELSA results report"
  country: "Elsaland (example data)"
  actions: NULL
  pas: NULL
  regions: NULL
  region_col: NULL
  layers: NULL
  scheme: NULL
  pa_threshold: NULL
  target: 0.3
  units: "ha"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4, dpi = 150, out.width = "100%"
)
library(elsar)

p <- params
# With no inputs, render the bundled example so the template works out of the box
if (is.null(p$actions)) {
  ex <- elsar_example_results()
  p$actions <- ex$actions
  p$pas <- ex$pas
  p$regions <- ex$regions
  p$region_col <- "region_name"
}
scheme <- if (is.null(p$scheme)) elsar_action_scheme() else p$scheme

x <- if (isTRUE(try(elsar:::.is_prepared(p$actions), silent = TRUE))) {
  p$actions
} else {
  elsar_prepare_actions(p$actions, scheme = scheme, pas = p$pas, pa_threshold = p$pa_threshold)
}
has_pa <- "pa_fraction" %in% names(x)
has_regions <- !is.null(p$regions)
has_layers <- !is.null(p$layers)

national <- elsar_summarise_actions(x, units = p$units)
by_region <- if (has_regions) elsar_summarise_actions(x, p$regions, p$region_col, units = p$units)
main <- if (has_regions) by_region else national
gap_national <- if (has_pa) elsar_protection_gap(national, target = p$target)
gap <- gap_national
if (has_pa && has_regions) {
  # Use the true national row (regions can miss planning cells along borders)
  gap <- rbind(
    elsar_protection_gap(by_region, target = p$target, include_national = FALSE),
    gap_national
  )
  gap$region <- factor(gap$region, levels = unique(as.character(gap$region)))
  attr(gap, "national_label") <- "National"
}
overlap <- if (has_layers) elsar_summarise_overlap(x, p$layers, units = p$units)

unit_label <- c(ha = "ha", km2 = "km²", m2 = "m²")[[p$units]]
fmt_area <- function(v) paste(format(round(v), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), unit_label)
fmt_pct <- function(v, digits = 1) paste0(formatC(v, format = "f", digits = digits), "%")
kable <- function(d, ...) knitr::kable(d, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...)

planning_area <- sum(national$area)
action_area <- sum(national$area[national$is_action])
```

## Key figures

ELSA assigned an action to **`r fmt_pct(100 * action_area / planning_area)`** of
the planning area (`r fmt_area(action_area)` of `r fmt_area(planning_area)`).

```{r key-protection, results = "asis", eval = has_pa}
g <- gap_national
cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Existing protected areas cover **%s** of the planning area. ",
    "ELSA proposes a further **%s** of new protection, ",
    "bringing the total to **%s** against a target of %s"
  ),
  fmt_pct(g$pct_current), fmt_pct(g$pct_new), fmt_pct(g$pct_total),
  fmt_pct(100 * p$target, 0)
))
cat(if (g$target_met) ": the target is met.\n" else
  sprintf(", leaving a gap of %s.\n", fmt_area(g$gap)))
```

```{r national-map, fig.height = 6}
elsar_plot_actions(x, regions = p$regions)
```

```{r national-table}
national_tbl <- national[national$is_action, ]
tbl <- data.frame(
  Action = national_tbl$action,
  Area = round(national_tbl$area),
  `% of planning area` = round(national_tbl$pct_of_region, 1),
  check.names = FALSE
)
if (has_pa) {
  tbl$`In existing PAs` <- round(national_tbl$area_in_pa)
  tbl$`Outside existing PAs` <- round(national_tbl$area_outside_pa)
}
kable(tbl, caption = paste0("Area of each action (", unit_label, ")."))
```

```{r protection-heading, results = "asis", eval = has_pa}
cat("\n## Protection and the", fmt_pct(100 * p$target, 0), "target\n\n")
cat(
  "*Existing PAs* is all area inside existing protected areas. ",
  "*New protection* is area ELSA assigns to Protect outside them.\n\n"
)
```

```{r protection-plot, eval = has_pa, fig.height = 4.2}
elsar_plot_protection_gap(gap)
```

```{r protection-table, eval = has_pa}
kable(data.frame(
  Region = gap$region,
  `Existing PAs (%)` = round(gap$pct_current, 1),
  `New protection (%)` = round(gap$pct_new, 1),
  `Total (%)` = round(gap$pct_total, 1),
  `Gap to target` = round(gap$gap),
  check.names = FALSE
), caption = paste0("Protection by region. Gap to target in ", unit_label, "."))
```

```{r regions-heading, results = "asis", eval = has_regions}
cat("\n## Actions by region\n\n")
```

```{r regions-plot, eval = has_regions, fig.height = 4.2}
elsar_plot_action_bars(by_region)
```

```{r regions-table, eval = has_regions}
acts <- by_region[by_region$is_action, ]
wide <- tapply(round(acts$pct_of_region, 1), list(acts$region, acts$action), sum)
wide <- wide[, colSums(!is.na(wide)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
kable(
  data.frame(Region = rownames(wide), wide, check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL),
  caption = "Share of each region's planning area assigned to each action (%)."
)
```

```{r overlap-heading, results = "asis", eval = has_layers}
cat("\n## Overlap with other layers\n\n")
cat(
  "The share of each layer that falls under each action. National representation",
  "of the features used in the ELSA run is reported by the run itself.\n\n"
)
```

```{r overlap-plot, eval = has_layers, fig.height = 4}
elsar_plot_overlap(overlap)
```

```{r region-profiles, results = "asis", eval = has_regions, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
cat("\n## Regional profiles\n\n")
for (r in levels(by_region$region)) {
  s <- by_region[by_region$region == r, ]
  top <- s[s$is_action, ][which.max(s$area[s$is_action]), ]
  cat("\n### ", r, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf(
    "ELSA assigns an action to %s of the planning area. The largest is %s (%s).",
    fmt_pct(sum(s$pct_of_region[s$is_action])), top$action, fmt_area(top$area)
  ))
  if (has_pa) {
    g <- gap[gap$region == r, ]
    cat(sprintf(" Protection rises from %s to %s.", fmt_pct(g$pct_current), fmt_pct(g$pct_total)))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
  print(elsar_plot_region(x, by_region, p$regions, p$region_col, r, title = NULL))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Methods

* Areas are calculated from the ELSA action map with
  `elsar_summarise_actions()`. Cell areas are planar in the equal-area
  projection used by ELSA (geodesic for longitude/latitude rasters), and cells
  cut by a region boundary are weighted by the share inside the region.
* Percentages are of the *planning area*: all cells with an ELSA value,
  including cells with no action.
`r if (has_pa) "* Protected-area cover is used as a fraction of each cell, unless a threshold was set. When protected areas are locked into Protect, *existing PAs* are Protect cells inside them and *new protection* is Protect outside them."`
